title: 배꼽이 빠지다 ≠ belly button falls out! Guess 3 Korean idioms in 3 seconds 😂 #learnkorean
caption:
Can you guess these 3 Korean idioms in 3 seconds? 😂

배꼽이 빠지다 — not “your belly button falls out”: laughing so hard
귀가 얇다 — not “thin ears”: believes anything you hear
입이 무겁다 — not “a heavy mouth”: keeps secrets

Say it: 배꼽 빠지겠어요 · 귀가 얇아요 · 입이 무거워요

How many did you get? Comment your score 0/3 – 3/3 👇

SYNK LAB · Korean idiom quiz #2 with Mongle.
#learnkorean #koreanlanguage #studykorean #koreanidioms
alt: Felt mascot Mongle hosts a Korean idiom quiz. A felt belly with a popping belly button, paper-thin felt ears and felt lips biting a dumbbell show the literal readings of 배꼽이 빠지다, 귀가 얇다 and 입이 무겁다; a laughing felt face, a tablet with a pile of shopping bags, and zipped lips with a locked box show the real meanings.
